service.description: Delete job runs older than daysToKeep, a chunk of rows at a time, each chunk committed on its own, so a large backlog is worked down over runs instead of rolling back whole. No chunk begins after maxSeconds (plans/archive/High-Level-Review.md HL-033).

actions.script: const basisTimestamp = new Date(ec.user.timestampMillis(ec.user.nowTimestamp) - daysToKeep * 86400000).toISOString() recordsRemoved = ec.entity.find("moqui.service.job.ServiceJobRun") .condition(ec.entity.conditionFactory.makeCondition("startTime", "<", basisTimestamp)) .disableAuthz().purge(maxSeconds)
